cases.title: Every pass copies the full array twice
process: Six real swaps retain temporary/read/write order; 16 comparisons are not optimized away.
Four source lifetimes for copy; local temporary exists only in six executed swaps.

cases.title: Exponential recursion without memoization
process: 41 distinct fib frames; left call completes before right call.
Repeated subproblems remain repeated source work.

cases.title: Primality test deliberately never exits early
process: 171 remainder operations, including redundant checks after a divisor was found.

cases.title: realloc and strcat for each character
process: Each successful realloc replaces the old allocation lifetime and updates p.
Each strcat reads its source through one and writes the destination range.

cases.title: Repeated strlen and needless double reversal
process: Two allocations survive their creating rev frames and are freed in main.
Four actual swaps across two calls; repeated strlen remains observed.

cases.title: Allocate a temporary vector for every dot product
process: Twelve multiply writes and four scratch allocations/frees remain.
Each out cell is written once after its own three-term sum.

cases.title: Append and recompute a list sum by walking from the head
process: Sum traversals grow 1,2,3,4 nodes; append traversal costs six links.
A freed node is never read; next is saved first.

cases.title: Implement a stack by shifting every element
process: Twelve visible shift writes are retained instead of replacing code with an abstract stack operation.

cases.title: Pass and return an entire record repeatedly
process: Copies preserve original.v[0]=1; outer call consumes the inner returned aggregate.

cases.title: Build jagged rows and copy each row to scratch
process: Two rows, one pointer array and two scratch vectors have distinct allocation identities.
Double-pointer loads and memcpy source bytes precede the sums.

cases.title: Copy each token before converting it to a number
process: strtok mutates the original copy; temporary pieces do not outlive free.

cases.title: Read lines and parse each number twice
process: Eight element scans actually execute; their writes must not be collapsed into four.
stdin reads and sscanf memory effects precede each sum.

cases.title: Repeated subtraction and redundant calls
process: Six gcd calls; each pair repeats identical subtraction work.
Compound assignments consume current destination and selected other operand.

cases.title: Shift an entire queue on every pop
process: Five memmove calls including final zero-byte operation.
Overlapping copy reads original bytes; no fabricated element-by-element destructive overwrite.

cases.title: Redundant deep copies and an explicit shallow alias
process: Value-copied Box aliases the same pointee; memcpy duplicates only pointed integers.
alias.v changes b storage, not a or c.

cases.title: Build prefixes then repeatedly measure and format them
process: Five prefix copies, five strlen and snprintf calls followed by visible puts output.
snprintf writes local string, puts reads it; no terminal output for snprintf.

cases.title: Nested shadow variables recreated for every iteration
process: Seven distinct x lifetimes: outer one, loop-body three, inner three.
Inner scope cleanup does not end outer x.

cases.title: VLA dimensions through redundant row copies
process: Three scratch VLAs each hold exactly three ints and end on return.
Row address bookkeeping remains separate from scalar element calculations.

cases.title: Statement macro repeated inside unused-work loops
process: Eight actual swaps despite net identity; each macro-local temporary is a separate lifetime.
STEP arithmetic is grouped by source macro expansion, not attached to unrelated operand.

cases.title: Conditional function pointer wrapped twice
process: Eight indirect callees resolved to four up and four down frames.
Return of first apply becomes second call argument without invented direct binding.

cases.title: Selection sort written with explicit labels and goto
process: Six comparisons and three exchanges including unnecessary self-swaps.
Goto edges preserve source labels and do not fabricate function return.

cases.title: Small BFS scanning every matrix column
process: 25 edge reads, short-circuit skips distance reads on absent edges.
Four queue writes enqueue newly reached nodes; no inferential graph shortcuts.

cases.title: qsort comparator needlessly copies complete records
process: Comparator frames preserve by-value copies; count may differ across C libraries.
qsort destination mutation and callback source reads remain connected.

cases.title: Allocate and copy the entire vector on every append
process: Six allocations and 15 copied elements; free(NULL) valid at first iteration.
No old-pointee read after free; replacement pointer only receives live q.

cases.title: Runtime-input counterpart of repeated string growth
process: Same redundant work as case 04, but condition input is obtained at runtime.
All 14 strlen calls should have runtime call evidence.

cases.title: Pure builtin work and actual side-effect calls
process: Source pure builtin expressions may be folded; observed constant plus source AST must identify their meaning.
touch is never substituted: four actual calls and writes.

cases.title: Three independent postincrements in one expression
process: Each postfix uses its old index; three distinct index objects have no unsequenced conflict.
Compiler-chosen valid evaluation order may differ, but out receives 9,12,15.

cases.title: Comma sequencing and redundant increment/decrement
process: Comma sequences increment before multiplication and x+=2 before consumption.
Redundant i++/i-- remains recorded.

cases.title: Conditional aggregate returns with repeated copies
process: Only selected make branch runs, four invocations total.
Aggregate result feeds p, then copy into q, before field reads.

cases.title: Compound literal copied repeatedly into a wrapper
process: Eight measure frames and eight compound-literal evaluations.
Source temporary lifetimes and by-value argument origins remain distinct.

cases.title: Convert decimal text through repeated power loops
process: Five power10 calls; ten redundant multiply steps in total.
Each char-to-int promotion and subtraction remains attached to digit expression.

cases.title: Recursive merge sort allocating at every merge
process: Eleven recursion frames, five temporary heap allocations.
Parent regions stay live while recursive views share portions of original array.

cases.title: Rebuild a complete Fibonacci table for every prefix
process: Eight allocations, repeated earlier-prefix work is retained.
28 table recurrence evaluations produce 54 total.

cases.title: Repeated full matrix scans with redundant minimum lookup
process: Two complete minimum scans each round; second duplicates first.
u<0 guards d[u]; all accesses are valid and all nodes reachable.

cases.title: Needlessly update packed fields and restore them
process: Field arithmetic uses promoted integer types; values fit all fields.
Changes to a do not alter b and vice versa; final a=5 b=7.

cases.title: Variadic helper copies argument list then reads both
process: va_copy duplicates cursor state; both loops read original payloads.
Each argument consumed twice; two invocations remain distinct.

cases.title: Small output operations flushed only at the end
process: Source output belongs to each printing call even if actual WASI write occurs at fflush.
Calls should not multiply terminal output by treating buffer copies as new output.

cases.title: Parse the same string with suppression and percent-n
process: sscanf records writes a=12 b=34 n=5; suppressed input does not consume a destination.
snprintf writes out and printf emits that buffer exactly once.

cases.title: Read every character twice using one-character pushback
process: Each digit has two library getchar calls but only one external input byte.
ungetc restores stream data; final newline terminates the bounded input.

cases.title: Flexible array rebuilt through unnecessary clone
process: Both 20-byte allocations include a flexible tail; memcpy covers header and values.
Pointer member-access extent is based on observed allocation, not fixed sizeof(Buffer) alone.

cases.title: Repeated assignments to nested designated records
process: Three complete record copies in each direction; nested changed element respects its byte offset.
Final x coordinates 3 and 4; totals 4,5,7.

cases.title: Two full transposes with deliberately redundant copies
process: 18 temporary scalar lifetimes copy each matrix element twice.
Array-of-array pointer parameters retain row stride and element read targets.

cases.title: Mixed argument types read twice with va_copy
process: Both cursors yield int -3, double 2.5, unsigned long long 9.
Different argument alignment and signedness must survive each read.

cases.title: Repeated floating conversions with exact binary fractions
process: Every value roundtrips double to float to double, then splits integer and fractional parts.
Exact selected values prevent floating comparison/printing ambiguity.

cases.title: Long decimal multiplication through many temporary strings
process: Sixteen partial products, sixteen shifts and sixteen additions; all decimal digits are in-bounds.
Intermediate reversed buffers stay alive until consumed, returned arrays survive their function frames.
Every temporary heap allocation is eventually freed. Native output compared with independent JavaScript BigInt prediction.

cases.title: Indexed insertion sort with repeated key reads
process: Native and IR output compared with independent JS numeric sort.
Short circuit prevents reading a[-1]; shifted writes remain individual source assignments.

cases.title: Pointer-based insertion sort on the same data
process: Same sorted result as indexed version; actual pointer reads and element-size movement retained.
position-1 is accessed only after position>a.

cases.title: Every comparison and move goes through a helper
process: Function-boundary version preserves all extra calls and temporary values.
Comparison and movement each read an element separately; no invented single read optimization.

cases.title: Bubble sort copies the complete array before every pass
process: Nineteen complete redundant copy roundtrips and 361 adjacent comparisons.
Do not hide wasted work just because final output equals insertion variants.

cases.title: Return live static slots while repeatedly overwriting the ring
process: Only three static slots exist; pointers 0/3,1/4,2/5 alias.
Static storage outlives all six slot function frames, and later writes affect older pointers.

cases.title: Repeated expression through records, index table and pointer table
process: Fifteen complete expression groups; address-index work must not replace loaded numeric leaves.
Each result checked against a saved independent JS calculation.

cases.title: Same expression with every read behind a function call
process: 45 real read_at calls, each returns the corresponding loaded value.
Source expression result is grouped without absorbing the function executions.

cases.title: Same numeric expression hidden behind an ordinary macro
process: Same fifteen values as records and helper versions; macro parameter storage does not exist.
Expression grouping may display invocation or expanded source but must preserve numeric result and source location.

cases.title: Repeated short-circuit and conditional side effects
process: Only three positive calls per pass; zero short-circuits and nonpositive branch decrements.
Conditional runs one update only; source arithmetic remains an observed result.

cases.title: Unbuffered counterpart of repeated getchar and ungetc
process: Same logical reads as case 39, but host input arrives one byte at a time.
Pushback getchar must not consume another external byte.

cases.title: Parse each token twice with independent end pointers
process: Six strtol calls; every end pointer aliases a distinct offset in original s.
Explicit p advancement observes commas and final null without out-of-bounds access.

cases.title: Whole-record copies with initialized padding bytes
process: All padding initialized before byte comparison; sizes may differ by ABI, values do not.
Eight complete copies remain visible despite identity.

cases.title: A small decimal parser with redundant per-character copying
process: Case-label chains, breaks and default arithmetic follow actual input.
Copy buffer and separate char variable are redundant but both writes remain.

cases.title: Separate-line VLA return with two source exit paths
process: First call returns from line 13; second returns from line 15.
Shared LLVM cleanup must not replace executed return source with closing brace.

cases.title: Early void return on a distinct source line
process: First copy_if exits on explicit return line; second reaches implicit function end.
No write to value on early return.

cases.title: Aggregate return on a distinct source line
process: Value snapshot and field writes remain correct.
Return event should identify return copy, not function closing brace.

cases.title: Macro-local scope with renamed temporary and split calls
process: Two distinct saved lifetimes; both macros execute despite net identity.
Compiler macro expansion should identify declaration independently of spelling.

cases.title: Ordinary scalar return as a location control
process: Without VLA cleanup or aggregate return storage, scalar return should map directly.

cases.title: Same VLA algorithm with only whitespace formatting changed
process: Exactly case 18 with whitespace-only changes; return-source mapping should be stable.
